Refund Policy

When refunds apply, how long they take and how to raise a dispute.

Effective from 22 April 2024

1. Overview

Online Saathi is a third-party technology platform that connects users with service providers. We do not directly provide or control those services. This policy explains the limited cases where refunds may apply and our role in them.

2. General refund terms

2.1 Completed services

Once a service, subscription or offer has been purchased and processed with the provider, no refund is given. Please check all details before paying.

2.2 Platform service fee

Platform convenience charges are non-refundable, even if the user or the provider cancels the transaction.

2.3 Third-party services

Complaints about quality, delays or non-delivery are handled under the provider’s own refund or grievance process. We help with communication but do not control the outcome.

3. Refunds for failed transactions

3.1 Automatic refunds

If a payment is deducted but fails at our payment gateway, the amount is refunded automatically to the original payment method within 3 to 21 working days. Only the net amount is refunded, excluding gateway charges, bank fees and taxes.

3.2 Disputed transactions

If a transaction appears successful but you do not receive the service, email {{email_support}} within 48 hours. We will investigate with the payment gateway and/or provider. A refund may be facilitated, but the provider makes the final decision.

4. KYC verification failure

If KYC verification is not completed and the account is not activated, the payment is not refunded.

5. Important terms

  • Role: Online Saathi is a facilitator; third-party providers are responsible for delivering services.
  • Liability: limited to refunding the transaction amount collected by Online Saathi, where applicable.
  • Indirect losses: we are not responsible for indirect losses, damages or inconvenience.

6. Changes to this policy

We may revise this policy. Updates will be posted on this page and/or sent by email or SMS.
